title: how do I get a red wine stain out of a white couch

messages.content: spilled wine on the white couch!!!!! need fix FAST!!!!!!

Act quickly! Here's what to do:

1. Blot the stain with a clean cloth or paper towel to absorb as much wine as possible. Don't rub, as it can spread the stain.
2. Mix a solution of two parts hydrogen peroxide and one part dish soap. Test on an inconspicuous area first.
3. Apply the solution to the stain using a clean cloth. Gently blot, don’t rub.
4. Rinse with cold water and blot again with a clean cloth to remove excess solution.

Let it air dry, and repeat if necessary.
what if i don't have peroxide around???

No problem! Here’s an alternative:

1. Blot up as much wine as possible using a clean cloth or paper towel.
2. Sprinkle baking soda over the stain to absorb remaining liquid.
3. Mix a solution of one tablespoon of vinegar, one tablespoon of dish soap, and two cups of warm water.
4. Using a clean cloth, apply the solution to the stain and blot gently.
5. Rinse with cold water, blot again, and let it air dry.

Hope you can save the couch!
